description: Step 1 of /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.184.html. Blocks above the pool's largest size (7.39 MB) are alloc_zeroed and dealloc'd on every collection (block_pool.rs; imp.rs:1192, :1263): at 62 MB live the OS shows 2.6 GB of freed large regions and 3.3 GB peak RSS. Also the copied_objects worklist is reallocated per collection, and mso_unreached_closures walks every binary stub looking for Resource stubs. Keep and reuse large blocks, keep the worklist, give Resource stubs their own chain. Signal: fz.runtime.gc gains bytes obtained from / returned to the allocator; a test pins a steady-state collection obtains none; peak RSS and time on the 32,000-line distiller run before and after. Note: generations (steps 2-3) make large to-spaces rare; measure whether this is still needed in the order built.
title: A collection obtains no memory from the allocator in steady state
